summary: AI-heavy day — Anthropic's IPO pricing (Nvidia's $10B investment, $70-78/share, $1.4T implied valuation, founders cashing out) is the unmissable story and takes rank 1, which pushes phone to 6/9 picks (~67%, slightly under the usual 70% target) rather than force-cutting genuinely major non-phone news. topics.working_title: Anthropic Prices Its IPO at $70-78/Share, Targeting a $1.4 Trillion Valuation
topics.why_now: Multiple outlets (TechCrunch, The Decoder, Techmeme citing NYT/The Information) confirmed the IPO price range, Nvidia's ~$10B planned investment, each founder cashing out ~$250M, and a further ~$10B Azure/Google Cloud commitment — all within the same day. Memeburn has nothing on the IPO roadshow yet.
topics.angle: Pull the roadshow details into one clear explainer: what the $70-78 range and $1.404T valuation actually mean, who's cashing out, and why Nvidia and the cloud giants are doubling down right as Anthropic goes public.
